cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openssl/fuzz/corpora/client && python3 -c "
import struct, os
for fname in os.listdir('.'):
    with open(fname, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    offset = 0
    has_ske = False
    has_cert = False
    while offset < len(data):
        if offset + 5 > len(data):
            break
        rec_len = struct.unpack('>H', data[offset+3:offset+5])[0]
        if offset + 5 + rec_len > len(data):
            break
        body = data[offset+5:offset+5+rec_len]
        pos = 0
        while pos < len(body):
            if pos + 4 > len(body):
                break
            hs_type = body[pos]
            hs_len = struct.unpack('>I', b'\x00' + body[pos+1:pos+4])[0]
            if hs_type == 0x0c:
                has_ske = True
            if hs_type == 0x0b:
                has_cert = True
            pos += 4 + hs_len
        offset += 5 + rec_len
    if has_ske:
        print(f'{fname}: SKE={has_ske}, CERT={has_cert}, size={len(data)}')
